body.objective: Determine whether the certified vanishing of the compensator-extended local anomaly cohomology promotes the one-loop Euclidean repair to an order-by-order local perturbative QME theorem in the formal tau-adic theory, or identify the first exact algebraic-renormalization obstruction.
body.stop_condition: Import WESS_ZUMINO_EXTENDED_LOCAL_BV_COHOMOLOGY from commit 69f01998d255455aebe3bbcb0872ae82cc698621 and LOCAL_ANOMALY_ANTIFIELD_COMPLETION_AUDIT from commit c6d1c0ba by exact hashes. State the formal tau-adic local functional algebra, filtration, regulator assumptions and quantum action principle needed at arbitrary loop order. Compute the complete antifield-dependent H^{1,4}(s_ext|d) and stable H^{0,4}(s_ext|d) modules in that algebra, including parity, total derivatives, canonical transformations, coupling redefinitions and every counterterm direction generated recursively. Prove either that every order-n consistency breaking is exact and removable by an admissible local counterterm while the induction hypotheses and algebra remain stable, or exhibit the first nonremovable class, filtration failure, unbounded counterterm tower or regulator incompatibility. Separate formal local perturbative restoration from convergence, global anomalies, Lorentzian renormalized products, residual transfer, states and unitarity. Land an exact recursive theorem/counterexample certificate, an independent cohomology and induction verifier, mutations that omit R(g_hat)^2 and positive-antifield sectors, and a paper/atlas lifecycle update.
body.current_gate: all-orders formal local algebraic-renormalization induction for the tau-adic compensator extension
body.forbid: no one-loop H^{1,4}=0 simply restated as an all-loop theorem; no quantum action principle or regulator stability assumed without a declared hypothesis and receipt; no finite-dimensional AFN0 check called complete; no strict pure-Weyl anomaly freedom; no compensator theory called quantum-equivalent to strict Weyl gravity; no local Euclidean theorem promoted to Lorentzian QME, Hadamard states, positivity, particles, scattering or unitarity
activates: formal all-loop local QME status for the compensator-extended theory
renormalized coupling and counterterm stability ledger
a properly scoped quantum foundation for the complex compensator-clock model
body.resource_hint: INDEPENDENT READY FALLBACK after the conformal-gauge-carrier search. Treat the all-loop statement as an algebraic-renormalization induction problem, not another coefficient scan. An exact failure of stability or of the quantum action principle in the declared algebra is a successful obstruction result.
notes: The certified one-loop compensator result changes the theory and already contains the independent R(g_hat)^2 counterterm direction.
A theorem may be conditional on a precisely stated local quantum action principle, but the condition must be machine-visible and must not be silently used to claim a constructed regulator.
Global anomalies and Lorentzian microlocal renormalization remain separate gates even if the formal local induction succeeds.
